channel.description: Latest articles from Women's Wear Daily (wwd.com)

item.title: Pete Davidson on Being Crocs’ New Ambassador, Maintaining His Individuality and Dressing Like a Dad
item.description: The comedian stars in the brand's new "Do Your Thing" campaign.

item.title: Maison Margiela Fetes Max Richter and ‘Joy’ Film Night After Oscars
item.description: The Los Angeles cocktail spotlighted the composer’s score for the spring 2026 campaign and a new short film featuring a youth orchestra.

item.title: Lululemon CEO Search Continues as Former Levi’s Chief Chip Bergh Joins the Board
item.description: The company’s Q4 profits topped expectations, but the outlook was tepid and everyone’s looking to the empty corner office.

item.title: Ring in the ‘Love Story’ Finale With These Sunglasses Inspired by JFK Jr. and Carolyn Bessette-Kennedy’s Signature Style
item.description: Plus, the exact shades worn by the older Kennedy himself: available to shop as we speak.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Marc Jacobs and Disney Reunite for Mickey and Friends Tennis-themed Collection
item.description: The curation features styles for the spring and summer seasons.

item.title: FP Movement and Barry’s Team Up for Co-branded Products
item.description: The line will be available for sale at more than 60 Barry's studio locations as well as Selfridges London.

item.title: Ferrari Roars Into London With a Lifestyle Flagship Full of Energy, Emotion and Italian Design
item.description: The new Ferrari store on the corner of Old Bond Street and Piccadilly is a temple to Italian style and luxury, with its own atelier and bespoke services.

item.title: Vera Wang, Fabrique Reveal Ready-to-wear Collaboration
item.description: The 37-piece collection focuses on soft tailoring, fluid silhouettes and a balance of structure and ease.

item.title: Marella Inks License With Area B for Beachwear Line
item.description: Marella's swimwear and cover-up collection will hit stores in April 2027.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Benedict Cumberbatch, Letitia Wright Feature in Prada Re-Nylon 2026 Campaign
item.description: Developed in partnership with National Geographic CreativeWorks, the campaign spotlights Prada’s Sea Beyond ocean literacy project.
